[!exec:cat] skip

stdin hello.txt
exec cat
stdout hello
exec cat
! stdout hello


[!exec:cat] stop

# Check that 'stdin stdout' works.
exec cat hello.txt
stdin stdout
exec cat
stdout hello

# Check that custom commands can read stdin
stdin hello.txt
quotedstdin
stdout '\Qstdin: "hello\n\n"\E'

-- hello.txt --
hello
